tool.name: mumemto merge
tool.command:
## Each partition's companion files have to sit next to its MUMs file under a shared ## basename: mumemto derives <prefix>.athresh and <prefix>.lengths from the path given. #for $i, $p in enumerate($partitions): ln -s '$p.mums' 'part_${i}.mums' && ln -s '$p.athresh' 'part_${i}.athresh' && ln -s '$p.lengths' 'part_${i}.lengths' && #end for
## The MUMs files are positional and space separated, not comma separated. mumemto merge #for $i, $p in enumerate($partitions): 'part_${i}.mums' #end for --output 'merged.mums'

repeat.name: partitions
repeat.title: Partition
repeat.help: One entry per mumemto partition to merge. All partitions must share the same anchor, i.e. the same first sequence.

param.name: athresh
param.label: Anchor threshold file
param.help: The .athresh file produced alongside it, i.e. from a run with anchor-based merge metadata

tool.help:
**What it does**
Combines multi-MUMs computed over separate partitions of a collection into a single set spanning every sequence. Splitting a large collection into partitions and merging afterwards is much cheaper than indexing everything at once.
Each partition must have been run with **anchor-based merging** (`mumemto -M -n`), and all partitions must share the same anchor — the first sequence given to each run. Only matches that survive in every partition end up in the merged set.
**Input**
Per partition, the three files mumemto writes with a shared prefix:
- `<prefix>.mums` — the tab-separated match positions - `<prefix>.athresh` — internal merge metadata that records which matches survived the anchor threshold; needed to merge again - `<prefix>.lengths` — per-sequence lengths
Add one *Partition* block per partition; at least two are required.
**Output**
- The merged `.mums` file, with one column of coordinates per sequence across all partitions - The merged `.lengths` file, listing every sequence with the anchor appearing once rather than once per partition. Downstream tools need this rather than any individual partition's lengths file. - The merged `.athresh` file, which lets the result be merged again with further partitions
